issues.title: Organization Schema
issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD schema with name, logo, and contact info to help AI identify your business.
issues.explanation: This issue matters for AI visibility because it helps search engines like Google understand your business's identity and display accurate information about your company. By adding an Organization schema, you're providing a digital "business card" that makes it easier for AI to recognize and showcase your business's name, logo, and contact details. This, in turn, can improve your online presence and make it simpler for customers to find and interact with your business.

issues.title: sitemap.xml
issues.recommendation: Create a sitemap.xml to help AI crawlers discover your pages.
issues.explanation: The absence of a sitemap.xml file on stripe.com is a significant issue because it hinders AI-powered search engines, like Google, from efficiently discovering and indexing all the website's pages. This matters for AI visibility because a sitemap.xml file acts as a roadmap, guiding AI "crawlers" (programs that systematically browse the internet) to all the important pages on a website, ensuring they are included in search results. By creating a sitemap.xml, stripe.com can improve its online visibility, making it easier for users to find their content through search engines.

executiveSummary: Our GEO audit yielded a score of 43/100, indicating significant room for improvement. The top issues include missing or incomplete technical files such as Organization Schema, llms.txt, and sitemap.xml, which help search engines understand our site's structure, as well as poor Heading Structure and incomplete robots.txt, which guides search engine crawlers.
